mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wb_project_member m WHERE m.project_id = p.id) AS member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wb_requirement r WHERE r.project_id = p.id) AS requirement_count

FROM wb_project p JOIN wb_project_member pm ON pm.project_id = p.id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.owner_id, p.revision, p.deleted, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
FROM wb_project p WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wb_project (name, description, owner_id, revision, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{ownerId}, 1, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
